data.label: gross
data.description: An amount counted in full, with nothing offset.

data.label: net
data.description: An amount counted after offsetting amounts are subtracted.

data.label: disbursement
data.description: The placing of resources at the recipient's disposal.

data.label: commitment
data.description: A firm, written promise to provide specified resources.

data.label: grant equivalent
data.description: A measure of the provider's effort: the amount effectively given through a transaction, equal to its face value multiplied by its grant element. A grant is given in full; a loan gives only the portion extended by lending below market rates, so more concessional terms yield a higher grant equivalent.

data.label: grant element
data.description: The gift portion of a loan, as a percentage of the amount committed. It is the face value less the discounted present value of the contractual debt service, over the face value.

data.label: current prices
data.description: Measurement is evaluated at current market prices, without adjusting for inflation.

data.label: constant prices
data.description: Measurement is evaluated against the price of goods or services at a different time to adjust for inflation. This adjustment could be via a chained volume series (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chained_volume_series) or a fixed-weight method.

data.label: bilateral ODA (DAC 1 aid type)
data.description: Official development assistance whose use the provider controls, whether it is extended directly to developing countries, earmarked through another organisation, or spent on development-related activities in the provider country.

data.label: multilateral ODA (DAC 1 aid type)
data.description: Official development assistance contributed to a multilateral institution active in development and pooled so that it loses its identity and becomes an integral part of the institution's financial assets.

data.label: in-donor refugee cost (DAC 1 aid type)
data.description: Other in-donor expenditure by the official sector on the sustenance of refugees and asylum seekers from developing countries hosted in the provider country.

data.label: non-grant (DAC type of finance)
data.description: Finance that DAC statistics record as a non-grant, a convention that covers loans, reimbursable grants, debt rescheduling, debt securities, mezzanine finance, equity and guarantees.

data.label: OECD headline ODA
data.description: The figure the OECD reports as a donor's ODA: net disbursements up to 2017 and grant equivalents from 2018, so years either side of the 2018 change are not comparable.

data.label: constant 2024 prices
data.description: Every year valued at 2024 prices and exchange rates, using the OECD DAC deflators, from ONE's conversion tables, so a change over time is not inflation or a currency movement.
